meta.parties: Samaradiwakara Et Al. v. De Saram

rules.statement: The terms of clauses VII and VIII vested the dominium in the surviving widow, with a fidei commissum in favor of Edwin Robert.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think that the terms of clauses VII and VIII, of the will vested the dominium in the surviving widow, with a fidei commissium in favour of Edwin Robert;"
